3.text: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

5.text: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

6.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

7.text: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’

8.text: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

10.text: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

11.text: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

12.text: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

13.text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

14.text: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

15.text: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
